name: kt cloud Daejeon Data Center
notes: kt cloud official IDC service page confirms KT's national data-center business; third-party directories place the Daejeon facility in Seo-gu, Daejeon, with colocation/IDC services. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LG Uplus Daejeon Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists LG Uplus Daejeon Data Center at 66 Gyeryong-ro 553beon-gil, Seo-gu, Daejeon; LG Uplus official sustainability material references IDC operations. Capacity not disclosed.

name: National Information Resources Service Daejeon Center
developer: National Information Resources Service / Ministry of the Interior and Safety
notes: Government data/cloud infrastructure center in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. MOIS announced a follow-on innovation ISP after the Daejeon center fire; press coverage confirms server-room operations and central government systems hosted there. Capacity not disclosed.

name: KISTI National Supercomputing Center / KISTI-6
developer: Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information / HPE
notes: KISTI's HQ is at 245 Daehak-ro, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. KISTI/HPE announced construction of KISTI-6, a 100% direct-liquid-cooled national AI/HPC supercomputing installation, with completion targeted for 2026. Treated as data-center/HPC infrastructure; electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: NAVER Data Center GAK Chuncheon
notes: NAVER official release identifies GAK Chuncheon as its first in-house data center; DCD and DataCenterMap report the Chuncheon campus at about 40 MW and operational since 2013.

name: Samsung SDS Chuncheon Data Center
notes: Samsung SDS official materials list the Chuncheon Data Center as a 2019 modular-type data-center reference; Korea Times reported the 39,780 sq m facility as Samsung SDS's fifth Korean data center. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Samsung SDS / Samsung C&T Modular AI Data Center, Chuncheon
notes: Industry report says Samsung C&T filed for permits to build a modular AI data center on a 37,475 sq m plot adjacent to Samsung SDS's existing Chuncheon center, with initial capacity around 2.4 MW. Samsung SDS said details beyond the permit filing were not finalized.

name: Douzone D-Cloud Center
notes: Douzone official location page describes the D-Cloud Center as a 24/7 cloud/data-protection facility at 130 Beodeul 1-gil, Namsan-myeon, Chuncheon-si. Capacity not disclosed.

name: GS Group Donghae AI Data Center Campus
notes: GS announced a 2.4 GW AI data center at Bukpyeong Second Industrial Complex in Donghae, with first 1.2 GW targeted by 2028 and full buildout around 2029; supported by later Gangwon/Donghae/GS agreement reporting.

name: Gangneung DC PEF 1GW AI Data Center Cluster
notes: Local media report a groundbreaking in Gangneung for a 1 GW hyperscale AI data-center complex by Gangneung DC PEF, planned around Gangdong-myeon/Aninjin-ri and Okgye-myeon, with phased completion targeted by 2028. Financing and final customer details remain uncertain.

name: Gangwon East Coast 1GW Data Center Hub near Gangneung and Donghae
notes: Government and Gangwon provincial sources were reported as considering a 1 GW cluster near Gangneung and Donghae, potentially up to 50 data centers averaging 20 MW each. This appears to be an area-level plan and may overlap with later Gangneung/Donghae project announcements.
